summary.para: Perform non-streaming chat completion inference on the service.
The chat completion inference API enables rich responses for chat completion tasks. It only works with the chat_completion task type.

NOTE: The chat_completion task type supports both streaming and non-streaming. The Chat completion inference API provides more comprehensive customization options through more fields and function calling support. To determine whether a given inference service supports this task type, please see the page for that service.
